description: Monthly IDR salary benchmark (median, p25, p75, sample size) per role x seniority cell over the last 90 days; cells under the minimum sample are suppressed. Needs your API key (Authorization: Bearer); a free key gets the free layer (largest-sample cells only). Same data as GET /api/v1/market/salary. Every result carries free_layer and paid_depth_url (free layer also dataset_depth_url).
name: get_salary_benchmark
title: Get salary benchmark
